Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: pricing & commit sizing (Aurora Health)

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Following up from last week’s demo. Per the MAP we promised a short weekly check to align on pricing/commit so we can lock timelines for a July pilot kickoff. Quick agenda:
- current evaluation status and outstanding blockers
- customer target commit size / timeline
- discount / credit ask and internal approval path
- next steps + owners

I’ve attached an updated MAP (Aurora_MAP_v3.xlsx) with the evaluation milestones and our proposed purchasing options. Can you confirm the internal budget holder and expected commit window this week?

Thanks,
Sean
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Chen <lchen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <trivera@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: 2026-06-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: pricing & commit sizing (Aurora Health)

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the note and the MAP. Quick updates from our side:
- Evaluation: clinical team completed the integration test (no major issues).
- Budget: finance expects to finalize the FY Q3 vendor list in the week of 6/22. We need a signed commitment and high-level SOW before that to qualify for Q3 spend.
- Target commit: we are aiming for a 12-month pilot at 10 reserved tokens/day equivalent (we use the term "commit sizing" in procurement).
- Discount ask: finance is asking whether Redwood can provide a 20% first-year discount + one-time evaluation credit to cover proof-of-concept costs.

I’m available 6/16 10:00–10:30 PT for a quick pricing call.

Best,
Lisa Chen
Director, Clinical Innovation | Aurora Health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Weekly MAP checkpoint: pricing & commit sizing (Aurora Health)

Looping in Aditya for approvals and Neha for legal/procure visibility. Notes from customer: 12-month pilot, target commit = 10 reserved tokens/day equivalent. They requested "20% first-year discount + one-time evaluation credit".

Proposed internal options (high-level):
1) Standard pilot: 12 months, 10/day reserved -> List price $X/month; 20% discount would get us to $Y/month. No SLA uplift.
2) Commitment + Dedicated option: 12 months, reserved capacity on dedicated pool -> requires approval from capacity and infra; higher baseline but better latency guarantees.
3) Evaluation credit: one-time $10k credit applied to first invoice to cover integration costs.

Questions for Aditya: can we approve the 20% discount in Sales Greenline, or do we need a manager sign-off? Also need clarity on whether we can attach a $10k credit without expanding contractual risk.

Action items (internal):
- LAU-1: Run quick margin calc for options 1/2 w/ proposed discounts (Owner: Lauren) — due EOD 6/15.
- ADT-1: Confirm discount approval path (Owner: Aditya) — due 6/16 EOD.
- NEH-1: Prepare minimal contract language for a pilot SOW + credit clause (Owner: Neha) — due 6/18.

[Attachment: pricing-model-commit.xlsx]

—Lauren
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: pricing & commit sizing (Aurora Health)

Thanks for the summary. Quick decisions:
- Discount: I can approve up to 15% at my level. Anything >15% needs VP sign-off. Document rationale (competitor pressure / strategic account justification) if we pursue 20%.
- Evaluation credit: OK to provide a one-time credit up to $8k if we attach clear acceptance criteria in the SOW (success metrics, data deletion timeline). Anything >$8k needs finance manager approval.
- Dedicated option: escalate to infra team for feasibility; that will require a capacity hold and longer lead time. Not recommended for tight July kickoff unless they accept limited latency expectations.

Internal next steps:
- ADT-2: If Lauren can rework pricing to 15% discount + $8k credit, I will greenlight and route to VP if customer insists on 20%/10k.
- ADT-3: I’ll start a short approval note for the VP with margin impact and strategic rationale (Owner: Aditya) — due 6/17 EOD.

I’ll be on the 6/16 10:00 PT call to confirm.

Aditya Rao
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for the call last week. Quick recap and agreed items so we can update the MAP and SOW:

Customer commitments & timeline
- Aurora: target pilot start week of July 6, 2026.
- Pilot scope: 12-month pilot, 10 reserved tokens/day equivalent.

Pricing & credits (agreed tentative)
- Redwood preliminary offer: 15% first-year discount + one-time $8,000 evaluation credit applied to first invoice.
- If Aurora needs 20% / $10k credit, we will escalate to VP approval; please confirm by 6/22 so we can route approvals.

Deliverables & owners
- Updated MAP and SOW (inc. acceptance criteria & credit clause) — Owner: Neha Kapoor — due 6/18 (attached SOW draft).
- Final pricing model for signature (pricing workbook updated for 15%/8k) — Owner: Lauren Bishop — due 6/18.
- VP approval pack (only if customer requests 20%/10k) — Owner: Aditya Rao — due 6/17.

Next steps for Aurora
- Confirm whether you accept the 15% / $8k combination or will request escalation to 20%/10k by 6/22.
- If yes to 15%/8k, we will send a pilot SOW + order form for signature and aim to lock the commitment before your finance window (week of 6/22).

Attachments: Aurora_SOW_draft_20260615.pdf (SOW draft), pricing-model-commit.xlsx (final pricing workbook)

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this — looking forward to moving to contract stage.

Best,
Sean
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
